svg.title: How Agello performs on iPhone 17 Pro
svg.desc: On iPhone 17 Pro · Apple A19 Pro, 12 GB: 1,668 tok/s peak prefill, 52 to 84 tok/s sustained decode, and 0.86 s to index a 40-page PDF on the Neural Engine.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: IPHONE 17 PRO · APPLE A19 PRO, 12 GB · IOS 27.2.1 · 64K WINDOW
